rounds.fact: WordPress launched in 2003 as a small blogging tool and eventually grew to power a huge share of all websites on the internet, blogs and full businesses alike.
Excite was one of the 'big five' web portals of the late 90s, and famously turned down the chance to buy Google's search technology for under $1 million in 1999.
Miniclip built its whole library around free browser-based Flash games, becoming one of the biggest casual gaming destinations before Flash was phased out industry-wide.
Answers.com built its early traffic by aggregating dictionary, encyclopedia, and reference content into a single searchable site, well before crowdsourced Q&A sites took over that space.
Blogger launched in 1999 and is one of the tools credited with popularizing the word 'blog' itself, before Google acquired it in 2003.
